      Workshop Overview
      Workshop overview
    
    
      
        The II International Workshop on Bayesian Statistics will take place on 4–5 June 2026 at CUNEF Universidad, Madrid. The workshop is organised by the Bayesian Working Group of SEIO and CUNEF Universidad.
      
      
        The meeting is planned as a single-track event with plenary talks, contributed sessions, coffee breaks, lunches, and a closing session. Registration is free thanks to the support of SEIO and CUNEF Universidad.

      José Miguel Hernández-LobatoAdvances in Scalable Gaussian Processes

text:
Practical information
  Venue and documents
  The workshop will be held at the LPC Campus of CUNEF Universidad in Madrid.



  
    
    Workshop venue
    Room: Aula F1.2 – LPC Campus
    Address: C. de Leonardo Prieto Castro, 2, Moncloa-Aravaca, 28040 Madrid
    Open venue map
  
  
    
    Group photo
    The group photo will be taken at the entrance of the ALMANSA campus on Thursday, 4 June 2026 at 20:00.
  
  
    
    Conference dinner
    Date: Thursday, 4 June 2026 at 20:30
    Restaurant: Sal Gorda, C. de Beatriz de Bobadilla 9, Moncloa-Aravaca, 28040 Madrid
    Cost: 40 EUR per person, payable at the restaurant.
  
  
    
    Contact
    For last-minute questions or problems, contact roi.naveiro@cunef.edu.

title: Program

  Workshop program
